reference_action: OP under-watered Steven after moving him outside to semi-shade. Advice was water and take back indoors; OP confirms doing so and improvement after two weeks indoors. Watering and sheltered indoor recovery are the validated bundle.

actions.action: Remove casing around propagation plugs if present

resolved.reason: Different shipping/corm context supplies neither drought watering nor returning the plant indoors. Unnecessary root disturbance is possible but no explicit likely major harm; humidity method is unspecified.

harmfulness.reason: “Take the casing around the plugs off” may unnecessarily disturb a stressed plant without evidence it has such a plug. The advice is not overtly destructive, but lacks a moisture check and can delay the needed rehydration.

specificity_accuracy.reason: The answer assumes Alocasia shipping damage and healthy “corms.” It does not address the stated outdoor exposure and admitted insufficient watering.

feasibility.reason: Plug removal is an ordinary manual task if plugs exist. “High humidity would help” gives no method or target, so the full advice is not a clear executable plan for this plant.
